description: Puerto Rico Climate Change Council Website is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Puerto Rico Department of Natural and Environmental Resources. Individuals, businesses, and municipalities working on climate adaptation in Puerto Rico can find information about climate change, local adaptation projects, and contact information for people working on climate change issues in Puerto Rico. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Heat, Flooding – Coastal, High Winds, Landslides, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
